newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco says 10-mth sales up 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Meralco says 10-mth sales up 11.1 pct.

text.p: Manila Electric Co, the Philippines biggest electricity distributor, said on Tuesday its sales volume in 10 months to October rose 11.1 percent to 14.772 billion kilowatt-hours (kwhs) compared to the year-ago period.

Sales to all Meralco customers rose during the period. Residential customers posted an 11.5 percent sales volume increase followed by the commercial customers at 11.2 precent and industrial customers by 10.8 percent compared to year-ago levels.
